findings.finding: Independent sensor periods retain a fixed capture cadence while a declared outage-duration matrix probes the recovery gap left by AL-017.
findings.direction_alignment: Improve realistic physics testing while retaining independent truth
findings.opportunity_or_risk: AL-017 never exceeded the recovery band. Longer outages can expose failed missions or transient returns; neither may be hidden by first-dwell scoring.
findings.engineering_cost: Three strict profiles, shared capture verification, sustained-recovery report and updated live windows
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-018 measures fixed longer outages with an equal-cadence reference
findings.verification_needed: Fifteen fresh clean-revision flights, unchanged reference and 250 ms traces, complete suffix recovery tests and live 3D inspection

overall_recommendation: Freeze a bounded duration matrix and preserve each measured outcome before considering controller mitigation.
evidence_gaps: Durations are synthetic stress parameters, not hardware calibration
Three seeds and discrete durations cannot establish a safe outage limit
Ideal attitude and contact supervision; unresolved yaw refinement remain
